summary: Addresses the 'no generic without attachments filter' gap (issue #158), per the user's detailed spec. New HasAttachments(card) is a boolean check (any attached Follower/Item/Spell, or a Follower/Weapon/Armor-designated token; an ordinary stat token does not count) -- new AbilityDefinition.RequireNoAttachments layers it onto whichever existing Target category is chosen instead of a new category per combination, matching Thunderous Legion/Elite Sentry's printed shape. Fixed a real pre-existing bug: the Attack primitive's own targeting check only ever looked for an attached Follower, so a Personality with an Item/Spell attached (or a qualifying token) was incorrectly still a legal Attack target -- now uses HasAttachments directly. Shared-file note: all changed files are within L5R.Core (rules engine) and its test suite, plus docs/ROADMAP.md -- a single rules-lane primitive change; no UI/client files touched.
validation: New NoAttachmentsFilter test (4 scenarios): an attached Item blocks an Attack target (the bug-fix case), a Follower-type token blocks a target with no card attachment, an ordinary Fire token does not block a target, and the generic RequireNoAttachments flag correctly rejects an attached Personality while accepting a clean one and an enemy Follower directly (an attachment is always a legal 'without attachments' target). Full suite: 98/98 core + 34/34 published + 8/8 deck format pass. bash tools/check.sh --skip-client passes.
remaining: The printed 'exception' case where a specific Attack overrides the no-attachments rule (Elephant Caravan/Strategic Strike's Reconnaissance-gated exception) is not built -- no imported card needs it yet, noted in issue #158.
